assumptions: All scenarios are estimates, not issuer forecasts or approved points
Remove specifically captioned net disposal gain; keep recurring supplier support instead of calling all other income one-off
Normalize volatile other-finance-cost credit separately; do not pretend it is an issuer-confirmed exceptional item
Model10%non-shareholder allocation after earnings adjustments; original source allocations remain unchanged
Growth is funded through an explicit incremental-return budget; standing WC/subsidiary reserve is included once
Maintenance replacement assumptions are explicit; observed total acquisitions are not relabelled as proven maintenance spending
Keep existing financing/financial income in parent earnings; do not add cash, net cash or subsidiary carrying values a second time
Future incremental borrowing and external common-equity issuance are assumed zero; existing financial costs remain in net earnings
Year1through5 are annual cashflow capacity forecasts from the review date, not H1doubling or reportedFY2026TTM
The12%bull discount is sensitivity only, not an approved exception to the15%normalBUYhurdle
counterEvidence: Only two years of parent cashflow detail reviewed here; group historical series is longer
Maintenance/growth split and future reinvestment returns are model assumptions
LatestFY2026cash/earnings and post-report actions still need explicit common-owner bridge before score admission
Subsidiary distributions, financial-income reinvestment and management control of surplus cash affect value
Source-period common count matching a public reference does not itself approve a current action registry
